overview.title: Overview
overview.content: Automated chocolate manufacturing logic programmed for Siemens S7-1200 PLCs with WinCC HMI recipe selection.

why.title: Why Built
why.content: To demonstrate multi-stage industrial automation mixing valves, thermal heating control, and batch processing.

techStack.title: Tech Stack
techStack.content: Siemens S7-1200 PLC, TIA Portal, Ladder Logic, WinCC Flexible HMI, and 24V DC motor drives.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.content: Synchronizing analog temperature sensor feedback loops with high-speed proximity sensor ingredient dosing.
